name: home-assistant
description: Operate the user's self-hosted Home Assistant safely. Safe-mutation discipline (back up + check_config before edits; .storage edits require HA stopped), a secret-safe deterministic inventory snapshot (ha-inventory, with content-hash drift detection that catches UI edits), and lean append-only gotcha capture (ha-note). References cover the .storage schema, the Assist voice pipeline, and the file/API-vs-UI capability map. Companions with the bitwarden-cli plugin for secret routing.
